preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 400,000.
Each edge connects two vertices within the range of 1 to n.
The graph is connected and contains no cycles.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == 1 if vertex i can be made a centroid by replacing no more than one edge, else 0
postconditions.description: The output array contains binary indicators for each vertex.

invariants.description: The number of vertices that can be made centroids is at most n.
